training_role: GroundAnything perception adaptation (projector + Qwen3 LoRA); not J1/OneJev identity training
split_policy: TRAIN only; MOT20-05 excluded; Refer-KITTI-V2 fit only; TAO Base-only; no evaluation labels

excluded_or_missing.BURST: TRAIN annotations exist but no legal TRAIN image root; excluded
excluded_or_missing.MOT20-05: frozen held-out MOT20 long-export sequence; excluded from all clean sources including RMOT26 copies

supervision_policy.MOT: mark==1, class==1, positive boxes; ignored/distractor classes are not person positives
supervision_policy.TAO-Amodal: frequency!=r Base categories only, one row per annotated category, no sparse negative labels
supervision_policy.Refer-KITTI-V2: legal fit videos, one row per valid labeled frame per expression
supervision_policy.RMOT26: normalized exact source question and all initial target boxes; no placeholder phrase
